verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships built-in Comply AI features that take over specific tasks inside the product. They produce risk scores, treatments and justifications from a risk description, draft and revise policies, extract vendor questionnaire answers, generate SSPs/POA&Ms and auto-generate IaC fixes. These are narrow, task-specific AI functions rather than a general in-product assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to. The MCP server connects external assistants, so it is a different story and earns no credit here. missing for 10: a general conversational in-product assistant, open-ended task delegation across workflows, evidence of agentic multi-step execution inside the app, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Comply AI for Risk automates the risk assessment workflow by producing inherent risk score, treatment, residual risk score, and justifications.
Leverage generative AI to save hours writing and refining policies with Comply AI for Policies.
Leverage Comply AI to automatically extract relevant answers to security review questions from vendor documents like SOC 2 reports and policies.
Generate SSPs, POA&Ms, and SPRS scores with AI to reflect real-time compliance data
Leverage auto-generated fixes for infrastructure as code so you can easily copy, paste, and deploy fixes to your cloud environment.
